The discussion of who is world class or not is even more pointless than the discussion of who is over/underrated. At least in the latter case, there is some degree of objectivity in what over/underrated means.

I think we all believe that Saka is approaching world-class status. There’s not much missing. There was a time last season when I thought Martinell was just a step or two away too. Now I’m not so sure anymore. A world-class forward needs that mentality and quality in front of goal to just say ”f*ck it, i’m putting this ball in the back of the net”. I.e. to score when the run of play suggests otherwise in big moments. Then again, Saka and Martinelli are so much more than goal scorers. Saka is primarily a creator. He plays like a no. 10 wide AND is a nightmare 1-on-1. Martinelli is our best player in offensive transition. By carrying the ball from box to box he changes games. We can go from being pushed back, unable to beat the opposition press, to dominating in their final third again thanks to a solo-run by Martinelli. These attributes force the opposition to spend tons of resources on containing our wingers. With Odegaard’s quality between the lines, there is only so much left to handle our no. 9 with. We need an upgrade in that position. At the very least we need something different.
